description: This file manages a registry of active Discord GatewayPlugin instances, providing functions to register, unregister, retrieve, and clear these instances. It acts as a bridge between REST-based handlers and WebSocket operations by maintaining a mapping from account IDs to GatewayPlugin objects.

methods.name: function resolveAccountKey(accountId?: string): string { resolveAccountKey
methods.description: Resolves an account ID to a key used in the registry, defaulting to a sentinel value if undefined.

methods.name: export function registerGateway(accountId: string | undefined, gateway: GatewayPlugin): void { registerGateway
methods.description: Registers a GatewayPlugin instance for a given account ID.

methods.name: export function unregisterGateway(accountId?: string): void { unregisterGateway
methods.description: Removes the GatewayPlugin registration for a given account ID.

methods.name: export function getGateway(accountId?: string): GatewayPlugin | undefined { getGateway
methods.description: Retrieves the registered GatewayPlugin for a given account ID, or undefined if not registered.

methods.name: export function clearGateways(): void { clearGateways
methods.description: Clears all registered GatewayPlugin instances (used for testing).
